paper_scope: JavisDiT++ v1.0 released-weight verification only; not JavisDiT-v0.1 preview and not a full training reproduction

evaluation.raw_reference_media: not released; distributional metric cache only
evaluation.evaluator: eval.javisbench.main from pinned official code; record third-party evaluator weights/revisions after setup
evaluation.paper_comparability: mini results are not directly comparable to full-JavisBench paper table

generation.seed_policy: record actual code/config seed and any per-rank variation before launch; do not invent a deterministic seed
generation.world_size: record before launch; official README shows one- and two-GPU inference examples

media_provenance_requirements: retain generated MP4 and extracted/generated WAV for every prompt
retain prompt row to output filename mapping
hash every generated media file and evaluator result
record failures and missing outputs; do not silently regenerate
stopping_rules: Do not launch if official model/dependency identity or hash cannot be recorded.
Do not score an incomplete prompt/output inventory as a full mini benchmark.
Do not call a mini result a reproduction of the full paper JavisBench row.
Do not begin training: raw Stage-2 TAVGBench YouTube media and full training provenance are unavailable.
